notes.content:

[h2] About Game [/h2]

After [i]Story of Eve - A Hero's Study[/i], the succubus Kassandra persuades you to train Eve using some "unorthodox" methods. Eve, marked with lewd runes, makes a diligent effort to become stronger. However, as the training progresses, Eve seems to start... enjoying the process. How will your special training methods affect Eve? Who knows...

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41075428/f2da870e0f0744a437d0bcde1244ef44da33a797.jpg[/img]

[h2] Game Features [/h2]
[list]
[*] The same exploration system as the original, but with enhanced maze-like features.
[*] Born from the rock, paper, scissors system, the brand-new card battles bring buckets of action-packed fun to Eve 2!
[*] Complete special missions to make Eve's clothes more sexy and increase her battle power!
[*] Your special training will turn the docile Eve into a domineering powerhouse... She might even counterattack you, so watch out!

[/list]

notes.title: v5.0 The final patch update!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IByrHvQ.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/V9d4vZi.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Jt3Gpiq.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CgnUG7Z.png[/img]
[b][h3]1. Added Russian language.

2. There is a chance to encounter a special boss in each level's unique room.

3. Hell mode is no longer an infinite level progression. After defeating the final boss for the tenth time, the player can proceed to the next stage (the level selection options will have a golden flashing border after completion).

4. The number of levels in Hell mode has been reduced, but the difficulty increases at a faster rate.

5. Dark protagonist bosses have been introduced in Hell mode, and there is a chance of encountering dual bosses in the later stages.

6. Bosses will have new attack patterns in different difficulty stages.

7. The existing relic fragments have been completely replaced with bomb coins and skill coins (previously obtained relic fragments will be automatically converted for you).

8. Skills are now uniformly activated using the right mouse button, Q key is used to throw bombs, and the scroll wheel can be used to switch throwing items.

9. The room on the right side of the Demon Lord's hall is now operational, and bomb coins and skill coins can be used to modify the corresponding abilities.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7VwKkmX.png[/img]

10. Arcane particles are no longer considered sacred relics but have become one of the skills.

11. MP value has been added, consuming MP when using throwing items or special skills. MP slowly recovers when not at full capacity.

12. Dice of Magic (white) - Increased the probability of obtaining bomb coins and skill coins.

13. Added navigation options to the ESC menu, allowing unfamiliar players to read instructions during the game.

14. The map size has been enlarged, increasing the walking and combat areas for all maps.

15. The dice system no longer randomly awards items upon victory but allows choosing between two options from the corresponding sacred relic type, increasing the variety of choices.

16. When all items are fully acquired, the cherub and dice will randomly grant bomb coins or skill coins.

17. The maximum appearance limit for options that tend to cause excessive inflation in certain numerical values has been set for all altars.

18. The tabs on the right side of the main screen have been removed, and certain UI elements have been optimized.

19. Three special bombs and three skills have been added.

[/h3][/b]
[h2][b]【Bombs】[/b][/h2]
[b][h3]Normal Bomb - High damage, short cooldown, low MP consumption. 

Vine Bomb - Detonates and binds surrounding enemies, restricting their movement. Medium-low damage.

Black Hole Bomb - Attracts nearby enemies to the center and explodes after a certain period of time. Medium damage.[/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/R7LP0p9.png[/img]

[b][h2]【Skill】[/h2][/b]
[b][h3]Arcane Particles - The basic skill that can now be self-modified. Soul Essence

Machine Gun - Fires rapidly like a Gatling gun, but requires consuming soul essence as ammunition.

Flame Armor - Can be toggled on/off. When activated, forms a ring of flames around the player, damaging nearby targets.

Water Breathing - Summons a massive wave that pushes away all enemies in front and retreats a distance after casting.[/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3Hln0Nl.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Kv1cDqK.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jeqiiL2.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jcRm31l.png[/img]

[b][h3]20.The following sacred relic items have been added:[/h3][/b]

[b][h2][God of War][/h2][/b]
[b][h3]Whiskey - Deals additional damage when using the Blink skill and knocks back enemies along the path.[/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/L5Uf00n.png[/img]

[b][h2][Arcane Wanderer][/h2][/b]
[b][h3]Cursed Doll - Normal attacks can mark targets. Upon death during the marking period, there is a chance to generate a revengeful ghost that pursues other enemies and explodes.

Flint - Leaving behind flames along the path when using the Blink skill.[/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/CYLapje.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hAaOnt1.png[/img]

[b][h2][Archangel][/h2][/b]
[b][h3]Scorching Blood - Increases your attack power when your health drops to a certain percentage.

Ginseng - Slowly recovers health when your HP drops to a certain percentage.

Instant Gel - After receiving multiple attacks, significantly increases defense for a period of time.

Solar Panel - Increases MP limit and recovery speed.[/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0gFLnvq.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/J0hHeIM.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dZKU8Mr.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2iIReuN.png[/img]

[h2][b][God of Crafts][/b][/h2]
[b][h3]Alloy Cube - Chance to fire additional homing missiles with normal attacks.[/h3][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/D16bj2J.png[/img]

--------------------------------------
Twitter : [url=]https://twitter.com/SandTravelerADO[/url]
Patreon : [url=]https://www.patreon.com/SandTraveler[/url]

notes.title: v4.0 Minor Update & Fixes (3/21)
notes.content:
[h3][b]1. The soul essence provided by the Little Angel will increase as the level gets higher.
2. When all items of a certain type have been collected, they will no longer appear in the corresponding rooms.
3. Fixed Japanese and Korean translation errors on the notice board in the Demon Lord's Hall.
4. Corrected some translations in the instructional signage.
5. Increased the probability and quantity of gift items dropped by each boss (approximately doubled).
6. Fixed an issue where some players were unable to trigger the heroine's mission. Now, when the affection level reaches LV3 full, the plot will not be triggered. Just send a gift again and press confirm to re-evaluate.
7. Quest items are no longer distinguished between main story or hell stages. They will drop as long as the designated boss is defeated.
8. Fixed an issue where dodging more than 60% of attacks resulted in complete invincibility.[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Waiting for the official release on 3/16 !!!
notes.content:
[h2]Thank you all for your long-awaited patience, we are about to officially launch.[/h2]

During the last period, we have removed the RPG MAKER version and temporarily disabled the achievement system. There will be new achievement content after the official launch.

[h2]Here are several major updates for the official version:[/h2]

[h3]1. Added the complete third level and Mia (Goblin's story)
2. Added the final level (Livia's Conspiracy)
3. Added Korean translation
4. Added Japanese voiceover
5. Upgraded all characters' final HCG to exquisite animations
6. The arcane particles can now increase the number of blocks
7. The ice staff can now reduce the distance and speed of monster dashes, and the upper limit has been changed to level 8
9. The poison staff has extended effect duration, and the upper limit has been changed to level 8
10. The gambling cloak can now increase 2 points initially
11. (tentative) The stick can now be used as a tool to enlarge bullets while retaining the original knockback effect[/h3]
====================
[h2]Future Update Plan:[/h2]

[h3]1. Adding joystick controller support
2. Using relic fragments
3. Adding more level items and combinations
4. More visual and sound optimizations[/h3]
====================
[h2]A message from the author ADO:[/h2]

Thank you all for your patience. Initially, I used RPG MAKER to create this game, but I did not anticipate the limitations of RPG MAKER's performance. As I am not an engineer myself, I did not know how to address these issues. Therefore, we decided to remake the game using Unity, which resulted in the original version no longer receiving updates. This caused many players to wonder if I had disappeared, and I deeply apologize for this!

As we are already in the sales stage, there is tremendous time pressure, and every extra day brings the risk of insufficient funds. However, we have tried our best to complete the game this week. Due to the tight schedule, there may still be many bugs or defects, and we ask for your understanding. Testing this type of game is truly a daunting task, but we will do our best to fix any problems after the release.

Thank you to all our fans who have supported us!

[url=]https://twitter.com/SandTravelerADO[/url]

notes.title: v3.1 Data Correction
notes.content:
[h3]We have found some errors in the value settings that caused the game curve to be weird
This adjustment has improved these problems.

However, these changes will not affect players who have already accumulated a lot of resources[/h3]

[h2]Proper game experience requires restarting the game[/h2]

[h3]We would also like to say thank you to all the players who helped us test the game over the past few days, which gave us more clues to understand where to make adjustments.[/h3]


[h2]We have fixed the following problems[/h2]

[h3]1. Partner's bullet will be stuck in the screen problem
2. The amount of soul essence obtained by monsters will be compounded under certain circumstances, resulting in instantaneous expansion of soul essence
3. The monster types in the challenge rooms and special rooms in Inferno mode were set incorrectly, resulting in no monsters of the correct difficulty level appearing.
4. The value of the money bag bonus is wrong, it should be accumulated for each level, instead of the current level bonus.[/h3]

notes.title: Last Devil v3.1 fixes and optimization updates
notes.content:
[h2][b]Thank you for your support, we will continue to update and adjust the errors.[/b][/h2]

[b][h3]The first DEMO version had a lot of balance errors that caused the numbers to inflate severely, this time many values have been corrected.[/h3][/b]

[b][h3]Interested players can try to restart the game experience.[/h3][/b]

[b][h2]Bug fixes[/h2][/b]
[h3]1.Wrong display of backpack tab.
2.Some sound effects in the game cannot be adjusted from the settings.
3.Monsters in special rooms cannot draw blood.
4.Battle scenes with bosses, players can attack in advance.
5.The text of the blood-sucking and soul essence altar in Simplified Chinese is wrong and cannot be run.
6.The value of the reward given by the blood-sucking altar is wrong.
7.When the type of props are full, the good feeling props are given.
8.Relic fragment disappeared.
9.Character standing on the edge of the map can not shoot bullets.
10.System prompt text description error.
11.Reading the panel value of the archive is wrong.
12.Charlotte boss battle, the map has an invisible object blocking.
13.When the treasure chest drop animation is performed, an error will occur if the backpack is opened at the same time.[/h3]

[b][h2]Optimization[/h2][/b]
[h3]1.Added system prompt text at the bottom of the interface.
2.Optimize the text layout of various languages.

notes.title: 2022/4/14 Props effect !
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Vm_z282pHL8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]Unity porting plan log[/b][/h1]

First, thank you for all your support. The Early Access of this game will be sold on Steam from 2021/11/11. Since there were no other resources in the past, I was the only one who developed the game using the RPG MAKER. During the development, nearly 70 percentage of the game content could not be realized due to the limitations of system. For example: the problems of the simple monster attack, blockstun and collision.

I think that the current final version of the game on the store page is already the limit of RPG Maker. It is rare to see that someone is willing to make it like this using RPG MAKER. It is a huge project. Also, the problem that most people complained to was delays. Obviously, the graphics and the special effects are simple, but there are frequent delays or serious frame drops. All these problems will be solved after the release of the remake.

(Thanks to everyone's support, we have small funds to seek technical resources, thank everyone)

[h1]A. Major Upgrade[/h1]

1. Performance upgrade

The performance has been improved overall, and the picture, operation, impact, and special effects have been completely upgraded. There will no longer be the problem of lag, and there can be more bullet on the screens and monsters at the same time. Compared with the previous version, players can hardly run the game with the maximum of 5~7 monsters in a scene and a simple bullet screen.

2. Better Combat Feedback

Each monster has its own physics operation. The knockback is no longer just a fixed distance, but a more detailed adjustment of the quality of each monster. The heavier the quality, the harder it will be push. On the contrary, small monsters can be easy to push. The bonus of items can increase the effect of skill.

3. Sprint skills

The new Sprint skills are smoother. Although the bullets will still cause damage during the displacement. Characters can pass through monsters comfortably and easier to escape. This has a great impact on the balance and design of the game. There are many restrictions in the previous version, and the balance and number of monsters are difficult to design.

4. Stable collision

In the previous version, the collision distance between the background and obstacles was often different from what players actually saw in the game. This caused players to get stuck easily when they walked around the map, especially players who were about to pass the game. This problem caused a lot of anger. The collision has been adjusted subtly in the remastered version, and players can also dodge at some angles.

5. More items upgrade

The effect of the items is also the core element of the game. This upgrade will enhance the maximum amount of each type of items as well as the effect of the items. The future update will even have a system for upgrading items. For example, when the number of Crossbows exceeds 6, they will be upgraded to laser waves, which can shoot without CD.

[h1]B. The Content which are Working on[/h1]

1. Relic system:

Players can obtain different quality fragments of relic by destroying parts of environment and fighting monsters during the game. You can exchange the collected fragments for permanent relic items when the fragments reach the specified quantity. The relics will have different functions, and you can freely choose to carry them each time you enter the stage.

(In addition to upgrade relic, the same quality of relics can be fused or use fragments to enhance the character’s ability.)

2. Item Skill

In the past version we designed the bomb item, but the response is not very good. It is not that it is useless, but too boring. We will add more interesting items. The skill slot will only have one slot available for items and use the [Q button]. There are three types of bombs which are one-time use, multiple use, and unlimited use.

For example:

【Soul essences Launcher】: Consume the soul essence on the player as ammo to quickly cause powerful damage to the enemy.

【Vine Trap】: Places a Vine Trap that traps a monster when it passes by.

【Various Bombs】: Normal bombs, toss bombs, fire bombs, black hole bombs, freezing bombs, etc.

【Black Hole Ring】: Create a temporarily black hole vortex, attract all surrounding monsters to the center of the black hole, and cause damage.

(These are some examples, there will be more items and effects.)

3. More diverse partner skill and combat skill:

I believe that players in the current version have seen the ultimate skill given to the protagonist by carrying the heroine. These effects can indeed make players look forward to, but I think it can be more interesting.

Each of the future partners will have the following skills. And you can increase the skill level by enhancing the intimacy with your partners.

[b]Charlotte (elf)[/b]

【Companion Skill】: Every X second, Charlotte fires an arrow at the nearest enemy while moving.

【Passive skill (after affinity)】: Increase the rate of critical strike by X%.

【Active Skills】

1. Arrow Rain: Shoot X of arrows forward at a very fast speed.

2. Accuracy Shot: It takes a short time to spell and shoot one power arrow with high with high damage.

[b]Kayla (Orc)[/b]

【Companion Skill】: Kayla turns into your shield with powerful body, and Kayla can block all long-range damage while moving.

【Passive skill (after affinity)】: Increase defense for X%.

【Active Skills】

1. Thorn Shield: Summons a temporary wall of thorns to reduce damage, and enemies who touch it will take damage.

2. Earthquake wave: Kayla stomped hardly to the ground to release a circular wave with Kayla as the center, and the enemy will be dizzied for a short time.

[b]Mia (Goblin)[/b]

【Companion Skill】 After entering the battle, the main character recover 0.5% of the maximum HP per second if he has not been attacked for 5 seconds.

【Passive skill (after affinity)】: Increase the recovery by X%.

【Active Skills】

1. Blessing:Immediately recover X% of maximum HP.

2. Curse Essence: Creates a white mysterious liquid on the ground centered on Mia for X seconds. When the enemy passes by, they will suffer from fear and run around for X seconds and decrease their movement speed and attack for X seconds.

The beta version of the remake will be release on 2022/5~. Players can switch in the Steam options.

(Because of the different systems, the saves of the original version will not be overwritten, and players who have purchased can switch at any time)

notes.title: 【Savannah-Beasts Territory】Last Devil v1.1.4 update log
notes.content:
[b]New stage【Savannah-Beasts Territory】
There will be up to 45 floors of rooms and 90 floor challenges of Hell Mode.
Embark on a new adventure to find the daughter of the Beast King.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UzYdWUi.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TOQiv2z.jpg[/img]

[b]●New character- Kayla[/b]
(2 new CG images of Kayla have been added)
[b]●Added 25 types of monsters. (Including elites)[/b]
[b]●Added 4 new bosses.[/b]
[b]●Added block skill (Require the company of Kayla to use the skill)
●Poison Staff - Effect update，Poison Staff's damage per second is now based on the current percentage of ATK.
●Bloodthirsty Worm - Effect update，The ratio of lifesteal obtaining first time has been changed from 5% to 3%.
●The boss in hell mode is no longer immune to poison and ice, but only immune to the effect of thunder. (paralysis)
●Added more sound effects.
●Added lobby gallery to review the intimacy scene of the first boss battle.
●Added Wishing Fountain upgrade.[/b]
After defeating Horned Troll in Savannah, players will obtain upgrade materials. Players can make a wish to obtain treasure 2 times every times you go out after upgrading Wishing Fountain.

[b]●Here's some of modifications for the shrines[/b]

Bloodsucking Shrine:
Added a reward for Easter eggs when the count of Bloodsucking shrine the is full.
(ATK+40/Defense+50/HP+300)

Decision Shrine (Savannah):
In the original of the new stage, lasts for 2 minutes, attack+30%/defense+30%/crit+20% crit damage+50%, changed to 3 minutes.

Also, there are 6 new items have been added:

1.Reduce HP to 1 & gain +20% Attack
2.Reduce HP to 1 & gain +30% Defense
3.Gain  Attack 2% of current HP
4.Gain  Defense 3% of current HP
5.Gain  Max HP 2x Attack
6.Gain  Max HP 2x Defense

[b]●We have adjusted some values in the game[/b]

1. Emerald (Large): Defense +20 changed to +35
2. Emerald (Small): Defense +10 changed to +20
3. Money-Spending Shrine: Defense -10 changed to -20
4. Bloodsucking Shrine: Defense +5 changed to +15
5. The Defense stone from magic stone store: Defense +2(was changed from Defense +1) per one piece you obtain.
6. The HP stone from magic stone store: HP+8(was changed from HP+5) per one piece you obtain.

[b]●Magic stone exchange system update[/b]

The original price of magic stone was:  ATK stone - 80 per magic stone, Defense stone - 80 per magic stone, HP stone - 60 per magic stone. 
The price will be higher based on the number of purchases now, and the limit that can be purchased will be increased according to the progress of the game.
(For the players who have already started the game, all magic stones will be recovered, and soul essences will be returned to players after updating)
The drop rate of magic stones in the game has also been slightly decreased. 
The original system has a slightly imbalance in the later stage of the game, and most players will also focus on collecting more magic stones. Hope this update can make players more focus on to the build of core items.
 
[b]●Large treasure chests no longer appear after defeating a boss in Hell Mode[/b]

Since there are as many as 90 levels in hell mode, players can basically collect all the items after the mid-term of the game, so players lose the strategy of choice. In response to this update, we have also decreased the difficulty of all monsters
============================================================

[b]Upcoming update:[/b]
1.	We are working hard on the Unity porting project.
2.	The demo version is expected to be released on Patreon in March.
3.	It is expected to be officially released to Steam in May. 
4.	We will try our best to finish the Unity porting, and we will update the original system before the completion of the Unity porting. Sorry for the inconvenience.><
5.	After the Unity porting project is finished successfully, all the original performance shortcomings will be improved.
6.	We are grateful for your support and your patient for waiting~

(Please give us support to increase the production progression and the quality improvement!)
